info.content: Opens when a product is added to the cart. Free shipping, set suggestions, order notes and the cart type (drawer or page) are in Theme settings > Cart. The drawer body uses the "Drawers and pop-ups" color scheme.

show_recs.label: Show product suggestions
show_recs.info: Picked from the cart: the same kit for kids or adults, then more of the same team, then the collection below. Products already in the cart, sold out, or offered in "Complete the set" are left out.

recs_collection.label: Collection that fills the row
recs_collection.info: Used when the cart gives fewer suggestions than the number below. Empty: "Our picks". A cart with only kids items uses the kids collection.

empty_collection.label: Empty cart button link
empty_collection.info: Pick a collection. Leave empty to link to all products.

empty_menu.label: Empty cart links
empty_menu.info: Its top links show as chips in the empty cart, straight into a category. Leave empty to show none.
